themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 6 this week compared to a 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 4700% increase (z-score: 17.76)—suggesting a sudden, coordinated poster campaign or enforcement gap emerged in the last 7 days.
evidence: 6 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 17.76 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Timing suggests sudden onset rather than gradual trend
reporting_angles: Who or what triggered the poster deluge this week? Is it political, commercial, or event-driven?
Is the city's removal contractor falling behind on enforcement in Midwood/Ocean Parkway?

themes_detail.label: Construction and Plumbing Surge
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints surged 423% to 70 last week versus a 13.4 weekly baseline (z-score: 11.94), indicating either a wave of unpermitted work, botched installations, or inadequate inspections across the district.
evidence: 70 general construction/plumbing complaints LAST WEEK vs. 13.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
323 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (242 alterations, 32 new buildings, 9 full demolitions) suggests high construction activity
reporting_angles: Are contractors in Midwood undertaking unlicensed or substandard plumbing/construction work? Interview residents with complaints.
Is DOB inspection capacity keeping pace with the 323 permits filed recently, particularly the 242 alterations?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Cluster Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Homelessness-related encampment complaints jumped 900% to 5 last week versus a 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.5), suggesting a nascent street homeless concentration in the district within the last 7-10 days.
evidence: 5 encampment complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
900% increase represents acute, recent change rather than chronic baseline
reporting_angles: Where in Midwood/Ocean Parkway are encampments clustering? Interview residents and outreach workers.
Has the city's homeless services response been deployed, or are encampments going unaddressed?

themes_detail.label: Indoor Air Quality Degradation
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints peaked at 9 three weeks ago—a 167% spike versus a 3.4 weekly baseline (z-score: 6.56)—potentially indicating mold, HVAC failures, or construction dust linked to the current building alteration surge.
evidence: 9 indoor air quality complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 3.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Temporal correlation with 423% surge in construction/plumbing complaints suggests linked causation (dust, mold from botched work)
reporting_angles: Is the construction surge causing indoor air contamination in adjacent residential units? Document cases.
Are landlords in older Midwood buildings failing to maintain HVAC systems or properly isolate renovation work?

themes_detail.label: Maintenance and Facility Issues Spike
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance or facility complaints jumped 392% to 8 this week versus a 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 4.53), suggesting rapid deterioration of public spaces, transit infrastructure, or municipal facilities.
evidence: 8 maintenance/facility complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No prior context available; warrants clarification on what specific facilities are failing
reporting_angles: What public facilities or infrastructure in Midwood deteriorated this week? Check streetlights, sidewalks, parks, transit shelters.
Is this a symptom of understaffing or deferred maintenance in the district?
